column1: # THE PRODUCTION-LINKED CORE TU / OBJECT / SYMBOL CENSUS.
# Derived from a FRESH build in a disposable detached worktree at the
# exact C0 commit, and from the build's OWN link line -- not from a
# source scan alone and not from the CENSUS01 inventory.
# SECTION 1 -- EVERY TU ON THE PRODUCTION LINK LINE, WITH ITS OBJECT,
# ITS DEFINED-SYMBOL COUNT AND ITS IMPORT COUNT. A TU with an
# import count of 0 that still contributes code is reachable only
# SECTION 2 -- THE SCOPE BOUNDARY, STATED EXPLICITLY.
# The census covers every TU on the production link line. The CORE
# SEMANTIC subset (type analysis, expression semantics, AST/IR, CFG,
# instruction selection, code generation, compiler driver and the
# supporting semantic boundaries) is the set of TUs whose class is
# one of CODEGEN, CODEGEN_JIT, CODEGEN_LEGACY, TYPE_ANALYSIS,
# IR_LOWERING, IR_TRANSFORM, REGALLOC, IR_EVAL, CFG, AST_SEMANTICS,
# The following TUs are OUT OF SCOPE and the exclusion is measured,
#   JSON, LSP, REPL, STRINGS, CONTAINERS, MEMORY, ASSEMBLER, SUPPORT
# SCOPE_INCOMPLETENESS=the census enumerates every TU the production
#   compiler links; it does NOT claim that every function in those TUs
#   is a distinct semantic authority. A function is a SITE only when
#   it is source-bound, production-reachable and makes a semantic
#   decision; the site inventory records the tested exclusions
